title: Interpretability Illusions with Sparse Autoencoders: Evaluating Robustness of Concept Representations
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical adversarial robustness of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) used to interpret LLM activations. It proposes an evaluation framework to test how easily concept-based interpretations can be manipulated. While it mentions safety and monitoring as motivations, it does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics as part of its methodology or benchmarking.
